summary: Grayscale Bittensor Trust (TAO), a Delaware statutory trust whose shares trade OTC under GTAO, reported via Form 8-K that its sponsor, Grayscale Investments Sponsors, LLC, and BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. executed on September 30, 2026 an amendment to the Amended and Restated BitGo Custodial Services Agreement dated June 5, 2026, making the Trust a direct party. BitGo continues safekeeping TAO in segregated fiduciary accounts, withdrawing TAO at sponsor instruction for Sponsor's Fee and Additional Trust Expenses; the prior custodial agreement terminated. Fork provisions permit BitGo to suspend or decline either branch. This is a routine custody-contract event, not a special situation.
